resources.string: Hold OK on a channel, film or show and choose Add to Favourites.
Removes this profile and its favourites and history. Sources are kept.

Your profiles, playlists, favourites and history have NOT been deleted — this is a database upgrade failure, and the data is still on this device.\n\nPlease report this so it can be fixed, and include the message below.
Choose what to remove for this profile. Playlists, favourites and downloads are not affected.
Hidden categories and items show again, renames and custom order are cleared, and moved-out items return. Combined categories, favourites and guide matches are kept.
Looks on GitHub for a newer OwnTV now and offers to install it. Your playlists, favourites and settings stay as they are.
Each viewer keeps their own favourites, watch history, resume points and Home rows. Kids mode shows only the categories you allow; a PIN stops anyone else from opening the profile.
What OwnTV shows when it starts: Home, the channel you watched last, your favourites, or a channel you pick.
A viewer with their own favourites, history and settings

Resync now fetches the latest catalogue and keeps everything already saved.\n\nResync and remove missing titles also allows removing titles the provider no longer lists. Your favourites, history and resume positions for titles that are still listed are kept.
A profile keeps its own favourites, history and Home. Add more later in Settings › Profile.
Start fresh, or bring back your profiles, playlists and favourites from a backup file or another device.
